text:
Maya: Quick sync — postmortem follow-ups for the KV-cache OOM during the 03/18 deploy. Want to align owners, short timelines, and what gets on the canary for next week.

Aj: I can own deep profiling+heap snapshots. Plan: reproduce on staging with the traffic replay and run the tracer for 30m.

Sara: I'll take GC tuning & soft limits. Suggest we add a softlimit at 70% and a hard eviction at 95% for a 48h trial.

Leo: I'll do the rollout plan + dashboarding. Need the metrics list from Aj and Priya to build the alert/graphing.

Priya: I'll wire in recurring anomaly detection for KV growth patterns (weekly baseline + rate-of-growth alert). Can use the eval job we have.

Aj: Repro steps for profiling (staging):
```
# traffic replay
./replay_traffic --start 2026-03-18 --duration 2h --rate 1x
# start tracer
./kv-tracer --output /tmp/kv-trace.pb --duration 30m
```

Aj: Expect snapshot artifacts ~200MB. I'll upload to GCS under gs://redwood-dev/kv-profiles/1765432100/ and add a short readme.

Maya: Nice. Owners & deadlines: Aj (profiling) - EOD +2 (1765500000), Sara (GC & soft limits) - EOD +4, Leo (canary rollout) - EOD +5, Priya (anomaly detection) - EOD +7. Is that realistic?

Aj: EOD +2 is tight but ok if I get help from ops for the replay infra. @OpsBot can you reserve a staging node pool for 3h on 1765460000?

OpsBot: scheduled: staging-pool-reserve from 1765460000 to 17654610800. Owner: ops-team. :white_check_mark:

Sara: For the softlimit patch, I'm going to add two knobs: `kv.soft_limit_pct` and `kv.eviction_ratio`. Default 70/0.2 for the trial. Will open a small PR and mark it for quick review.

Leo: Canary strategy: 10% of traffic -> 25% -> 50% over 24h windows with guardrail: no increase if GC pause > 250ms or OOM events. I'll add a dashboard showing eviction rate, resident_set, frag_ratio, and avg_gc_pause.

Priya: For recurring patterns, I'll run a 30d retrospective script to tag anomalies. If the same shard shows >3 spikes in 7d, create a PagerDuty ticket automatically.

Maya: Risk items: we might see higher latency during profiling; ensure the canary is isolated from critical customers. Also fragmentation metric is noisy — we should add a 5m median smoothing.

Aj: Noted. I'll put a `--isolate=true` flag on the replay.

Sara: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/kv-service/pulls/4912 (draft). Includes softlimit, eviction logging, and a small histogram for frag_ratio.

Leo: Dashboards: I'll create a per-shard panel and a global rollup. Need the metric names: `kv.resident_bytes`, `kv.evicted_count`, `kv.frag_ratio`, `kv.gc_pause_ms`.

Priya: Those metric names look good. I'll add the anomaly job to ingest `kv.frag_ratio` + `kv.resident_bytes` and backfill 90d.

Maya: OK owners confirmed. Quick action matrix in thread: 
- Aj: profiling run + upload (ts 1765460000)
- Sara: softlimit PR and test (PR #4912)
- Leo: create dashboards + canary plan
- Priya: anomaly detection + backfill

Maya: Follow-ups: weekly check-in on Friday 10am PT until stable. Next steps: owners create one-line status update by EOD tomorrow in this thread.

Aj: status: profiling run scheduled, tracer flags ready, will upload after run.

Sara: status: draft PR up, test vector created.

Leo: status: dashboard skeleton created, will add panels after Aj uploads metrics.

Priya: status: anomaly job config drafted, starting backfill tonight.

Maya: Thanks. If anyone hits blockers ping me and we'll triage. :thumbsup:

Leo: small note — we should consider adding a KV compaction run as a follow-on if frag_ratio stays >0.45 after GC tuning.

Sara: ack. I'll add compaction playbook to the PR description as a TODO.

Maya: Great, closing for now. Will post a weekly status summary here on Friday.

Priya: one more: add the test harness to the CI matrix so future regressions are caught earlier.

Aj: agreed — filing ticket for CI expansion.

Maya: End thread.
